subject: Crestline: Clearance request for special deployment covenants and pricing
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@crestlinethera.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Victor Hale <procurement@crestlinethera.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Deployment & audit asks for Crestline POC

Jordan — great meeting earlier. To move forward with the POC and a 12‑month committed reserved pool we need to capture a few nonstandard requirements in the contract: 

- EU data residency guarantee (primary and DR in EU regions only)
- Quarterly on‑site audit window for our security team (up to 3 person-days)
- Ability to run a 3rd‑party scanner and collect audit logs for 90 days (longer than standard)
- On‑prem connector requirement for a small subset of PHI workflows (we will provide a scoped list)

We are comfortable with a multi‑month pilot, but procurement will need a pricing concession for the upfront work and the scope above. Can you escalate to get clearance for a 30% first‑year discount and the additional audit allowance? I've attached a speculative SOW and a simple audit matrix.

Thanks — Elena
VP Information Security, Crestline Therapeutics
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Deployment & audit asks for Crestline POC

Team — forwarding Crestline's asks. Key items for Deal Desk + Legal review: 

- EU‑only residency and DR requirement (customer will refuse US standby)
- Quarterly on‑site audits, 3 person‑days, and 90d retention for audit logs
- On‑prem connector for PHI subset (they want install access and a support SLA)
- Pricing: requesting 30% discount for year 1 (committed reserved capacity)

Attachments: Crestline_SOW_v2.pdf, Audit_Covenant_Matrix.xlsx

Action: Can Legal & Security confirm whether we can provide the audit window and extended log retention without escalating to execs? If not, please advise required approvals and suggested alternative language. Also need Deal Desk guidance on the discount band and commercial guardrails.

— Jordan
Account Exec (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:29:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Deployment & audit asks for Crestline POC

Jordan / Marissa — reading this with Legal. Quick notes: 

- EU data residency: we can offer EU primary + EU DR (region constraints) but we need to lock which cloud region(s) and add a 'data locality' SLA that limits cross‑region failover unless requested.
- Quarterly on‑site audits: customer wants 3 person‑days every 3 months — that is aggressive. We can offer annual or semiannual standardly. Quarterly requires exec signoff and a tracked cost recovery clause (we should bill travel/time or apply an audit fee).
- 90d audit log retention: feasible; we must confirm storage/retention cost — likely a small uplift.
- On‑prem connector: requires a Scoped Connector Agreement (technical + install runbook). We'll need a security checklist, and Limitations of Access must be explicit.

My recommendation: seek Exec clearance for audit cadence + pricing concession. Draft redlines: charge for on‑site audit days at cost + require 30 vs 60 day scheduling notice; discount cap at 25% with a 12‑month revenue commit and non‑refund of set up fees.

— Markus
Head of Contracts
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Deployment & audit asks for Crestline POC

Looping in CS and Security ops (Soojin). From a delivery POV: the on‑prem connector is implementable but will require 6 weeks of engineering + 2 weeks of validation and an installation SLA (we should include a fixed setup fee). Quarterly audits also mean a rotation of support staff and potential disruption.

Commercial ask on discount: 30% is likely too deep; we've taken 25% as an upper band on similar deals when heavy services were included. If Execs prefer to hold pricing, we can propose a 20% discount + $75k professional services credit to cover connector work and the first audit.

I will update the SOW to reflect delivery time and a PS schedule.

— Marissa
Customer Success Lead
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Gregor Novak <gnovak@crestlinethera.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@crestlinethera.com>, Victor Hale <procurement@crestlinethera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Updated proposal and ask (details + options)

Gregor / Elena — attached is an updated SOW and an audit covenant matrix that lays out our options so procurement can pick the path that fits Crestline's risk model. High level we can offer three options: 

1) Standard: EU residency, annual on‑site audit, 60d log retention, 15% discount (no connector)
2) Hybrid: EU primary + EU DR, semiannual on‑site audit, 90d log retention, 20% discount + $75k PS credit (connector scoped)
3) Premium (requires Exec approval): EU primary + EU DR, quarterly on‑site audits (3 person‑days each), 90d log retention, on‑prem connector, 30% first‑year discount + waived setup fee

We prefer Option 2 as a workable balance, but Jordan will escalate for a decision if Crestline insists on Option 3. Please let us know which option you prefer.

Attachments: Crestline_SOW_v2.pdf, Audit_Covenant_Matrix.xlsx

— Jordan
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Exec clearance request prepared for review

Jordan / team — I drafted an internal clearance memo for Exec review that summarizes the risk, commercial impact, and recommended approval path. Key bullets: 

- Risk: Quarterly on‑site audits expand operational burden and increase potential exposure surface; require a cost recovery mechanism.
- Commercial impact: Option 3 (customer requested) equates to ~28% effective discount when PS credits and waived fees are considered.
- Ask: Exec signoff to approve Option 3 with the conditions below: 
  * Audit days to be charged at cost beyond 3 person‑days per year
  * 60‑day scheduling window and a max of 2 on‑site audit events in any rolling 12 months unless pre‑approved
  * Connector install limited to a preapproved image and runbook; no direct root access; support via named engineers only
  * Discount capped at 30% first year only, with renewal reverting to list prices plus a minimum 12‑month committed spend

If Execs approve, we will update the SOW and route to DocuSign with the redlines attached. I have a short blurb ready for Scott/CTO if needed.

— Laura
Head of Revenue Operations
From: Scott (CEO) <scott@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec clearance request prepared for review

Laura / team — read the memo. I approve Option 3 on a conditional basis: we can accept the quarterly audit cadence and the connector install only if all of the following are enforced and signed off by Legal & Security ops first: 

- Cost recovery clause for audits (customer pays travel & per diem; additional audit days billed)
- Technical constraint: connector runs in customer‑managed enclave; no inbound admin tunnels; data plane isolation verified by our security ops
- 30% maximum discount explicitly tied to CR‑2026‑1147 and capped to the first 12 months; invoice schedule to include non‑reimbursable setup fee that is nonrefundable
- Explicit insurance/indemnity language for PHI processing approved by Legal

Please prepare the final DocuSign packet and the short executive blurb I can send to Elena confirming the conditions. Jordan — close this with procurement once Legal confirms redlines.

— Scott
CEO, Redwood Inference
